title: Console code editor: serve Monaco from the Console's own assets instead of a public CDN
body:
Filing-gate category: ① user-visible defect with a named landing site (follow-up owed by landed work: objectstack#25569).

Reader who acts: the objectui card thread that takes this (app-shell + plugin-editor owner). The maintainer approved adding `monaco-editor` as a runtime dependency on 2026-10-25 (director thread, option A: self-host instead of a CDN allowance), so the human-floor call named in the objectstack-ai/objectui#11800 triage is already made; the PR still gets the maintainer's review as usual.

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectui monaco in:title,body` → 1 hit (#11800, closed; follow-ups objectstack-ai/objectui#11857 / objectstack-ai/objectui#11858 named there). `jsdelivr` → same hit. No open card covers self-hosting.

## Problem

The Console's code editor (Monaco, the editor component of VS Code) fetches its core at run time from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/monaco-editor@0.55.1/min/vs` through `@monaco-editor/loader`'s default config. Any deployment that cannot or will not reach that CDN loses the editor:

- air-gapped and offline installs today;
- every install once the Console document's content-security-policy lands (objectstack#25569), which deliberately lists no CDN in `script-src`.

Where it is used:

| Surface | File | Without the CDN |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Studio JSON source tab | `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/JsonSourceEditor.tsx` | plain-text fallback (`useMonacoFallback`) |
| html / react page source editor | `.../metadata-admin/previews/SourcePageEditor.tsx` | plain-text fallback |
| metadata form code fields | `.../metadata-admin/widgets.tsx` (`CodeWidget`) | plain-text fallback |
| `plugin-editor:code-editor` page component | `packages/plugin-editor/src/MonacoImpl.tsx` | **no fallback: stays on "Loading..."** |

reach: measured once through the public UI — browser smoke on objectstack#25569's branch (showcase, `@objectstack/console@18.0.0` dist), the CDN script request is refused and reported by the policy; the metadata-admin surfaces show the textarea.

## Proposed change

1. Bundle `monaco-editor` and point the loader at it: `loader.config({ monaco })`, with the language workers imported through Vite's `?worker` so they ship as same-origin assets under `/_console/assets/`.
2. Do it once, in a shared spot both app-shell and plugin-editor use, so the two copies of `@monaco-editor/react` don't drift.
3. Keep `useMonacoFallback` for a failed chunk load, and give `MonacoImpl` the same fallback.
4. Load the editor lazily (it already is behind `LazyCodeEditor`), so the cost is paid only on screens that open an editor.

Cost to state in the PR: `monaco-editor` adds a few MB of lazy chunks to the Console dist (measure before/after `du -sh dist/assets`); it does not change first-paint size if the lazy boundary holds.

## Acceptance

- With objectstack#25569's policy on, the four surfaces above open the full editor, and the browser reports no `script-src` / `worker-src` violation.
- No request goes to `cdn.jsdelivr.net` from the Console.
- `MonacoImpl` shows the plain-text fallback when the editor chunk fails to load (test).

Business rationale: authors edit page source, JSON metadata and code fields daily in Studio; a textarea loses syntax highlighting, validation markers and folding on exactly those screens. Offline customers lose it today; every customer loses it once the CSP ships.
